loze / at Time

at Time

Property

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e is the case or is occurring at t

Note

This relation doesn't necessarily relate an eventuality to the entire period of time when it occurs; for example, WWII started in 1939 and ended in 1945, but it was still in course in 1943, so it entertains the relation loze:atTime with 1943 too

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
